assertion: COMPANY: direct qualifying share owner is identified from supported evidence.
deferredBehavior: G2.3 protects COMPANY economic qualification and beneficial_owner projection; G2.4A separately protects evidence sufficiency and requirement resolution.

assertion: LLP: qualifying rights to surplus assets are evaluated using LLP semantics.
deferredBehavior: G2.3 protects LLP surplus-asset qualification and beneficial_owner projection; G2.4A separately applies the same evidence-sufficiency boundary.

assertion: Corporate holder creates an InformationNeed until ultimate natural persons are resolved.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A protects one semantic CURRENT_OWNERSHIP_AND_CONTROL InformationNeed for a potentially qualifying legal-entity holder without selecting a question or document action.

assertion: Percentage chains multiply deterministically.
deferredBehavior: G2.2 protects exact percentage-chain multiplication; G2.3 consumes the pinned result without recomputing it.

assertion: Independent qualifying paths aggregate.
deferredBehavior: G2.2 protects independent-path aggregation; G2.3 separately interprets the pinned aggregate under policy.

assertion: Ranges remain ranges/min-max rather than being silently converted to exact percentages.
deferredBehavior: G2.2 protects range arithmetic; G2.3 protects exclusive-threshold interpretation with exact endpoint semantics.

assertion: Cycles cannot silently produce a numeric answer.
deferredBehavior: G2.2 protects relevant-cycle detection; G2.3 preserves incomplete cycle-bearing results as indeterminate.

assertion: LLP: qualifying majority-management appointment right produces controller_appointment.
deferredBehavior: G2.3 protects explicit LLP majority-management qualification and controller_appointment projection; G2.4A separately protects evidence-based resolution and legal-entity needs.

assertion: Risk checkpoint HIGH invalidates attestation-only closure and produces documentary gap without bespoke screen logic.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A protects policy-driven strength/risk sufficiency: HIGH risk prevents attestation-only closure and produces a semantic PolicyGap/InformationNeed without generating a document request.

assertion: Positive registry control fact may create a candidate claim.
deferredBehavior: G2.1 protects candidate-claim creation; G2.3 protects explicit qualification; G2.4A separately protects policy evidence sufficiency.

assertion: Absence of PSC condition-4 data does not negatively resolve the requirement.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A protects POSITIVE_ONLY/PSC-silence semantics and NO_DATA: neither may negatively resolve R06.

assertion: Ambiguous veto/decision rights route to REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than automatic UBO determination.
deferredBehavior: G2.3 protects REVIEW_REQUIRED assessment and prevents automatic qualification; G2.4A preserves that precedence while analyst action generation remains G2.4B.

assertion: Customer declaration alone cannot resolve R08.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A protects that applicant-originated declaration evidence does not satisfy R08's configured independent-source requirement.

assertion: Numeric evidence strength alone cannot bypass independent-source requirement.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A protects explicit source-origin classification, distinct durable-source counting and the configured independent-source minimum independently of numeric strength.

assertion: Companies House PSC information may corroborate but must not automatically become final UBO conclusion.
deferredBehavior: G2.4A permits explicitly independent PSC evidence to resolve R08 corroboration while proving it creates no qualifying-person or R01 UBO conclusion.

assertion: Material missing PSC may create reportable discrepancy workflow.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B deterministically emits POTENTIAL_DISCREPANCY and a host-neutral analyst-review intent for an explicit unmatched PSC/MLR fact; legal report submission remains outside UBO Control.

assertion: Difference caused only by PSC-vs-MLR definition mismatch is not automatically reportable.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B preserves an explicit PSC_MLR_DEFINITION_DIFFERENCE as NON_REPORTABLE_DEFINITION_DIFFERENCE and never fabricates statutory reportability.

assertion: Non-material discrepancy records rationale without automatically invoking report workflow.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B records an explicit NON_MATERIAL assessment and rationale without creating a regulatory-report action.

assertion: Fallback cannot activate merely because DiscoveryService returned NO_DATA.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B preserves NO_DATA in ResolutionAttempt history and requires a current authoritative asynchronous exhaustion decision before fallback eligibility.

assertion: Fallback cannot activate when required measures were not actually completed.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B blocks FALLBACK_REVIEW_CANDIDATE while pre-fallback requirements, customer-resolvable needs, specialist routes or relevant operational blockers remain incomplete.

assertion: Review package and positive exhaustion decision record measures taken and reason fallback was permitted.
deferredBehavior: G2.4B creates a case/policy/graph-pinned review package from durable attempt, evidence, calculation and reasoning references; the full immutable DecisionSnapshot remains G2.4C.
